cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el importe de los egresos manuales de caja, desglosado por caja registradora, en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cm.amount) AS egresos FROM cash_movement cm JOIN cash_session cs ON cs.id = cm.session_id JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY egresos DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja_registradora, SUM(cm.amount) AS total_egresos FROM public.cash_movement AS cm JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cm.session_id = cs.id JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué asientos registrados no cuadraron entre debe y haber en enero de 2026? Indica el código, la fecha, el total al debe y el total al haber de cada asiento.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.code, je.entry_date, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 ORDER BY je.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.code AS code, je.entry_date AS entry_date, SUM(jed.debit) AS debit, SUM(jed.credit) AS credit FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 LIMIT 50
